webSelections.naturalAttributes: For these integral tables: natural(L)=sourceBase+(L-1)*growth; use delta natural(new)-natural(old), preserve all other explicit script/item contributions; do not overwrite total stats from template on each level change
webSelections.missingGrowth: Only H021/G059 AGI/AGIplus selected0; all explicit fields retained
webSelections.levelGain: X04 commits each level with natural delta and one new unspent point before synchronous original HeroLevelUpEvent; stripping inside callback occurs before W019 and ends XP transaction as already specified
webSelections.learning: requires alive native HERO, a current learnable slot, one unspent point, next rank below cap, declared hero-level and explicit tech requirements; commit point and rank once then emit original learning callback once
webSelections.learningRequirementMeaning: minimum level is admission for a new learned rank, not a periodic rule unlearning an existing rank; script-added levels are not silently converted into paid skill points
webSelections.strip: Apply X04 XP/level; subtract natural-growth delta; remove one point per actual lost level, first unspent then reverse paid-learning history, decrementing current rank of the recorded logical slot down to0; do not synthesize learning or level-up events
webSelections.callbackSideEffects: Do not reverse arbitrary original script learning effects (e.g. A084 +500 max/current mana) without an explicit source reversal; native level-based ability contributions update to actual new rank
webSelections.scriptRankWrites: Direct add/remove/set ability rank does not synthesize spending, refunds or learning events; consumes no paid-history entry; later stripping a recorded slot clamps rank at0 rather than reviving removed abilities
webSelections.insufficientPointHistory: No negative unspent points or invented history; retire only available records; explicitly scripted grants remain outside paid history
webSelections.slotMapping: Logical paid slot history must be preserved/mapped by the separate skin/ANeg transaction; do not infer mapping from names or blindly replace with current template heroAbilList
webSelections.save: Persist actual ranks, paid slot history, unspent points, natural component and explicit resource state; no level/learning callback replay
